page.overview:
What is Bosatsu Jizo?

The Bosatsu Jizo was a lawful good demigod from Kara-Tur focused on the welfare and education of children. It typically appeared in the guise of an ancient human monk carrying a non-magical wooden bo staff, though it could take the form of any intelligent creature. It was a master of all defensive martial arts.
